name: 10 ft. Patio Umbrella with 8 Sturdy Wooden Ribs and 3 Adjustable Heights in Beige
material: chinese hardwood frame w/t polyester fabric, 8 ribs
description: Enjoy a cool and refreshing outdoor experience with the California Umbrella 9' Round HardWood Frame Market Umbrella. The sturdy chinese hardwood frame and weather-resistant polyester canopy make this umbrella perfect for providing shade on sunny days, while the stainless steel pulley lift system offers easy setup and adjustments. With a range of attractive color options, this umbrella is sure to match your outdoor décor. Measuring 108 inches long x 108 inches wide x 99 inches high, it provides generous coverage for your outdoor activities.
